update_rule.attempt_failed: increment selected action score by one
update_rule.fallback_completed: decrement selected action score by one, floored at zero

selection_rule: choose admissible action with minimum score; fixed priority breaks ties
primary_question: Does explicit experience remain selectively usable and revisable under fixed admissibility?
controls: admissible space remains constant throughout the sequence
same admissibility with different Q can yield different behavior
an unknown consequence cannot silently update Q
claim_ceiling: A deterministic mechanism with explicit persistent tabular experience state can retain, use, and revise action-specific experience to alter future behavior under a fixed admissible-space interface.
